name: TIE Bolt
description: The TIE Bolt, also known as the TIE podracer, was a custom-made demo podracer created as a gift for Imperial Admiral Rellen, from Grakkus Jahibakti Tingi. The podracer was stolen by Sebulba following a failed heist at the Hutt colosseum on Nar Shaddaa. Volo Bolus prevented Sebulba from escaping, causing the TIE podracer to crash and be destroyed.
